booking_drafts_recovery_idx.name: booking_drafts_recovery_idx
booking_drafts_recovery_idx.where: "booking_drafts"."sms_consent" and "booking_drafts"."booked_job_id" is null and "booking_drafts"."recovery_texted_at" is null

jobs_visit_has_technician.name: jobs_visit_has_technician
jobs_visit_has_technician.value: "jobs"."status" not in ('en_route', 'in_progress', 'done') or "jobs"."technician_id" is not null

jobs_closed_links_cleared.name: jobs_closed_links_cleared
jobs_closed_links_cleared.value: "jobs"."status" not in ('done', 'cancelled', 'expired') or ("jobs"."tech_link_hash" is null and "jobs"."manage_link_hash" is null)

users_technician_profile.name: users_technician_profile
users_technician_profile.value: "users"."role" <> 'technician' or ("users"."address" is not null and "users"."emergency_contact_name" is not null and "users"."emergency_contact_phone" is not null)

users_sign_in_method.name: users_sign_in_method
users_sign_in_method.value: ("users"."role" = 'technician' and "users"."phone" is not null) or ("users"."role" <> 'technician' and "users"."email" is not null)
